name: edge_main
note: Edge of Town, game_state 9. Snapshots the roster and parties every frame, runs the 8-item menu (9 with Dragon's Cave when story_flags bit 31 is set) and dispatches by edge_state: 10 Begin Adventure, 15 Training Maze, 20 Dragon's Cave, 25 Resume, 30 Prepare, 35 Suspend, 40 Book of Movement, 45 Settings, 50 Back to Town.

name: menu_input
note: Reads the pad for a menu: returns 4 for circle (confirm), 2 for cross (cancel), 3 square, 1 triangle, 5-10 shoulder/select/start, 11-14 for the d-pad, and moves the two cursors passed in.

name: edge_enter_maze
note: Begin Adventure / Training Maze / Dragon's Cave: fades out (edge_fade_out), prints 'One moment, please', reloads FIGHTMSG and the maze data. The destination is next_place (0xff, 0xfe, 0xf6), set by the caller.

name: edge_resume_adventure
note: Resume Adventure: restores parties from parties_saved, lists every member of other parties who is out of town, and makes the chosen one's party current if any member's status is below 0x20; enters the maze at the first member's saved area/x/y/facing (next_place 0xfc). Moves anyone saved at area 0x17 (4,11) to (5,11).

name: edge_suspend_game
note: Suspend Game: copies parties to parties_saved, sets next_place 0xfb (save screen), then 'Thank you for playing ... press O to resume'.

name: edge_prepare
note: Prepare for Adventure: Inspect Character (edge_inspect) / Reorganize Party (edge_reorder) / Back.

name: edge_inspect
note: Inspect Character at the Edge of Town: status screen, Cast Spell, Items, Sort Items.

name: edge_cast_spell
note: Casting outside battle from the Edge of Town: healing (2d4, 2d8, 3d8, full), cures by status bit, raising from dead or ashes (vitality test), identify, and a stat-or-alignment boon menu (SISETU 0x11e-0x127).

name: status_has
note: status_has(char, k): 0 alive and hurt; 1 poison 0x04; 2 paralyzed 0x20; 3 stone 0x40; 4 dead 0x80; 5 ashes 0x100; 6 afraid 0x01; 7 K.O. 0x10; 8 confused 0x02; 9 asleep 0x08.

name: edge_identify_menu
note: Item identify submenu (SISETU 0x6a).

name: edge_identify_item
note: Identifying an item: fail, touched it, cursed, identified (SISETU 0xf0-0xf2, 0x76).

name: edge_use_item
note: Using an item outside battle at the Edge of Town.

name: edge_reorder
note: Reorganize Party: move a member to another position.

name: edge_settings
note: Change Settings screen at the Edge of Town (Jpn/Eng rows patched by english_only.asm).

name: book_of_movement
note: Book of Movement (転生の書): imports a character from Gaiden III (Scripture of the Dark) or Gaiden IV (Throb of the Demon's Heart) by name, password and sex.

name: edge_fade_out
note: Fades the screen's sprites and the music out over 32 frames.

name: edge_give_item
note: Give an item to another member.

name: edge_drop_item
note: Drop an item (refuses equipped ones).

name: edge_bar_print
note: Prints text file F string N at row Y: (y, file, n, flag). File numbers index text_files.

name: edge_text_at
note: Prints text file F string N at (x, y): (x, y, file, n, flag).

name: dice
note: dice(n, sides, bonus): n dice of 'sides' plus bonus, the sum of n rolls of 0..sides-1 plus n.

name: card_check
note: Polls the card (_card_info, then _card_clear/_card_load on a new card), up to 10 tries; result in card_status.

name: card_poll
note: One _card_info: card_status 0 ready, 1 error, 2 new card, 4 no card.

name: card_free_space
note: Sums the sizes of the files on the card; sets card_status bit 8 when 14 or more of 15 blocks are used.

name: card_find_save
note: Looks for bu00:BISLPS-02691PSWIZDIM; erases it if it isn't 0x4000 bytes (bit 0x40), sets bit 0x10 when there's none.

name: card_format
note: Formats bu00: (up to 8 tries).

name: card_create_save
note: Creates the save file with its icon and title header (via 0x800ab27c).

name: save_write
note: Builds the 0x2400-byte save image at save_image (layout in docs/re/F-edge-save.md), checksums it and writes it to the card after the 0x200-byte header. Checked against two game-made saves (scripts/re/savefile.py).

name: save_read
note: Reads the image back into RAM, restores every block, then checks the checksum (card_status 0x20 if it differs).

name: save_screen
note: game_state 0x32: the Save screen (check card, format, overwrite, saving, failed, stop saving?).

name: load_screen
note: game_state 0x33: Load Data from the title. On a bad checksum prints 'data is corrupt' and resets the game data (save_data_reset); else rebuilds the roster and parties and goes to town.

name: roster_restore
note: Rebuilds all 20 roster records from the 0x90-byte images at 0x80086880 (the reverse of roster_snapshot).

name: save_image_unpack
note: Restores the game data from the save image still in RAM (save_image), as save_read does after reading the card, and checks its checksum.

name: continue_from_ram
note: game_state 0x36: the title's first option after a save this session (ram_save_valid): restores from the RAM image without reading the card, then goes to town.

name: save_data_reset
note: Resets the saved game data: map bits, story flags, progress_bits, party table, settings, Boltac's stock (from Item +0x1a), the seen bitfields. Only called when a loaded save's checksum fails.

name: parties_restore
note: Copies parties_saved (0x8008e620) into parties (0x8008f8c8).

name: mcard_print
note: MCARD's text printer: (x, y, file, n, flag); expands text_files[file] string n and draws it.

name: maze_menu
note: game_state 0x34, START in the maze: Investigate / Look for Companions / Save and Suspend / Go On with Another Party / Back (SISETU 0x1ae-0x1b2).

name: look_for_companions
note: Finds members of other parties on the party's exact square (area, x, y); adjacent squares only give 'faint traces'. Lists them with their worst status and lets them join (up to six); removes them from their old party. Doesn't touch items or gold.

name: maze_save_suspend
note: Save and Suspend in the maze: writes the square into each member's roster area/x/y/facing, copies the current party into parties, snapshots both, then the Save screen (next_place 0xf9).

name: party_snapshot
note: Copies parties (0x8008f8c8) into parties_saved (0x8008e620); the save holds the copy.

name: title_screen
note: game_state 5, the title: first option is New Game, or Continue (state 0x36) once ram_save_valid is set; second is Load Data (state 0x33).

name: mode_bytes_store
note: Stores five mode globals into 0x8008c4d0-0x8008c4d8 before a save. Swapped with mode_bytes_load: 0x800796aa goes to +7 and 0x8007966a to +6, but they come back from +6 and +7.

name: mode_bytes_load
note: Restores the five mode globals after a load (two of them swapped; see mode_bytes_store).

name: parties_saved
note: 20 party records (0x36 each), the copy the save holds; party_snapshot fills it, parties_restore and Resume Adventure read it.

name: save_image
note: The 0x2400-byte save image (layout in docs/re/F-edge-save.md); stays in RAM after a save.

name: card_status
note: Memory card result bits: 1 error, 2 new card, 4 no card, 8 not enough space, 0x10 no save, 0x20 bad checksum, 0x40 erased a wrong-sized save.

name: next_place
note: Where a screen sends the game next (main reads it): 0 town, 0xff Begin Adventure, 0xfe Training Maze, 0xf6 Dragon's Cave, 0xfc resume in the maze, 0xfb save from Edge of Town, 0xfa save from the maze, 0xf9 save from the maze menu, 0xf8 save from town, 0xfd back to Edge of Town; 1-2 catalog/Compendium.

name: ram_save_valid
note: Set to 1 when a save completes; the title then offers Continue (from the RAM image) as its first option. Cleared by Load Data.

name: ram_save_bad
note: Set by save_data_reset and when the RAM image fails its checksum; Continue is refused while it's set. Cleared on entering town.

name: edge_substate
note: State within an Edge of Town entry.

name: debug_flags
note: Bits toggled only by an unreferenced debug menu in JOUKA (0x800a6c40): 4 a new character gets EXP 0xffffffff, 8 gold 0x7fffffff, 0x10 class change sets EXP 0xffffffff.

name: new_char
note: Work record for character creation (a Roster), copied to roster[roster count] at the end.

name: class_hp_die
note: Starting HP: class_hp_base[c] + rand 0..class_hp_die[c]-1 (14 classes, 16 bytes).

name: class_hp_base
note: Starting HP base per class.

name: class_start_weapon
note: Starting weapon per class (item id; index 14 is the Faerie's), given with flags 0x7000.

name: class_start_armor
note: Starting armor per class (index 14 the Faerie's), flags 0x6000.

name: class_start_extra
note: The 5% extra item per class (index 14 the Faerie's): rand_upto(99) > 94.

name: training_create
note: Character creation: name, race (base stats), sex (+1 Str male, +1 Vit female), alignment, bonus_roll, class (by alignment, Valkyrie female only, minimums reachable with the bonus), stat distribution, then age 15-20, 100 gold, HP and starting gear.

name: training_rename
note: Change Name.

name: training_class_change
note: Change Class: level 1, EXP 0, age +3, stats reset to max(race base, new class minimum), equipment unequipped except cursed, first-level spells of the new class's school.

name: bonus_roll
note: Bonus points: 7-10 (20/21), 17-20 (20/441), 27-30 (1/441); each value in a band equally likely.
